title: 복사기 화면 읽기: 몇 장, 어떤 색으로?
objective: You can find the colour, side and number-of-copies settings on a Korean copier screen and understand basic messages such as 용지 부족 and 용지 걸림.
summary: Read the buttons and messages on a Korean copier screen to make simple copies on your own.
note: The screen on this sheet is an example. Real machines may use slightly different words.

task.title: Read the copier screen
task.line: Use the buttons, the sample screen and the messages on page 1 to answer each question.

items.text: Choose it to copy a paper.
items.example: 이 서류 두 장 복사해 주세요.

items.text: Choose it to make a paper into a file.
Choose it to use both sides of the paper. One side only is 단면.
Enter how many copies you want here.
Press it after you choose everything.
Press it to stop or go back.

steps.en: put your paper on the glass
choose black and white or colour

sections.heading: Reading the screen and messages
paragraphs: Sample screen — [복사] 색상: 흑백 | 컬러 · 면: 단면 | 양면 · 매수: 1 · [시작] [취소]. Check three things first: 색상 (colour), 면 (sides) and 매수 (copies).
Messages: 용지 부족 = out of paper. 토너 부족 = low toner. 용지 걸림 = paper jam. If you see one of these, tell a staff member.

exercises: Read the screen and answer in English: How many copies? Colour or black and white? One side or two sides? — 색상: 컬러 / 면: 단면 / 매수: 4
Which button do you press? Choose 시작, 취소 or 스캔: ① 매수를 잘못 눌렀어요. ② 이 종이를 파일로 만들고 싶어요. ③ 다 골랐어요. 이제 복사해요.
What does the message mean? Write it in English: ① 용지 부족 ② 용지 걸림 ③ 토너 부족
Fill in the blank with 흑백 or 컬러: ① 이 문서는 글씨만 있어요. ____으로 복사해요. ② 가족 사진이에요. ____로 인쇄해요.
Put the steps in order, following 'How to make a copy': 시작을 눌러요 / 종이를 놓아요 / 3을 눌러요 / 복사를 골라요
answers: ① 취소 ② 스캔 ③ 시작
① out of paper ② paper jam ③ low toner
종이를 놓아요 → 복사를 골라요 → 3을 눌러요 → 시작을 눌러요
